note: Modern cards have cooled since July as reprints caught up with demand, while out-of-print alt arts and vintage keep climbing. This week's picks lean toward out-of-print climbers and modern cards that look like they've found a floor.

picks.reason: Out-of-print rainbow Charizard that has climbed steadily all year (+32% in 90 days, +63% in a year) with no sharp spikes. Slow, steady demand is the healthiest kind.
Sun & Moon tag team alt arts keep setting new highs while modern cards cool off. Up 126% in a year. It jumped 29% this month, so buying on a quiet week beats chasing a spike.
The 30th Celebration reprint put the original Base Set Charizard back in the spotlight, and it has kept climbing (+17% in 90 days). Vintage trades less often, so prices move in steps.
Evolving Skies is long out of print and its Eeveelution alt arts keep climbing (+22% this month). An affordable way into the most collected set of the era.
Same story as Sylveon V: out-of-print Eeveelution alt art, up 38% in 90 days. Up 31% this month, so it's moving fast; set a price and be patient.
Cheapest of the climbing Evolving Skies Eeveelution alt arts, up 72% in a year and still rising.
Fusion Strike alt arts have been firm while modern prices fell. Mew V is up 20% this month and 51% in a year.
Steady, quiet climber (+19% in a year). Greninja demand is reliable and this Sun & Moon print is out of print.
Down 29% from its summer level after the September Prismatic Evolutions reprints, but flat for two weeks. Eeveelution SIRs have historically recovered once reprint waves end.
The set's top chase is down about 30% from its peak after reprints and is still drifting slightly lower. Worth watching for a floor rather than rushing.
151's Blastoise SIR is about a quarter below its summer high and ticked up this week. 151 cards have strong nostalgia demand.
Down 22% from its high but up 5% this month, an early sign the drop is over. Eevee cards are perennial favorites.
Crown Zenith is out of print and its Galarian Gallery cards rose earlier this year, then gave some back (−29% in 90 days). Looks like a pullback, not a collapse.
Down 40% in six months and leveling off. Charizard demand rarely stays down, but Obsidian Flames had a big print run.
Down about 75% from launch as Chaos Rising was opened, and now flattening. The set is still in print, so the bottom may take a while.
Down 32% in six months. Mega Lucario Z headlines February's Flowing Fists set, which could bring fresh attention to Lucario cards.
Down 61% from its peak and still falling (−29% this month) as Ascended Heroes reprints keep landing. If you own it, consider selling; if you want it, wait.
Same reprint pressure as Mega Gengar: down 33% this month with no sign of a floor yet.
30th Celebration's generous pull rates pushed prices down fast, and Japan is reprinting the set in January 2027. Prices are still finding a floor, so don't rush to buy.
Up 80% in six months, but it just fell 18% in a week. That can be the start of a cool-off; risky to buy right now.
Delta Reign came out November 6. New-set prices usually fall in the weeks after release as more boxes get opened, so early prices are fragile.
